projectState.summary: Byte 13a is approved, merged into `main`, and the Claude review artifact has been cherry-picked. It adds `docs/persistence-records.md` as a docs-only persistence prep companion to `docs/persistence-checkpoints.md`, defining durable record families for sessions, musical events, player thought request/response/acceptance, slow-thought playback windows, song sketches, deterministic proposals, model proposal text, checkpoints, and moments. It separates replay payloads from seek-and-continue generator state, records the future grid-vs-performed pitch gap, and banks the rule that model prose is data rather than executable instruction. Byte 13b is the next clean slice: add the first append-only SQLite/local-backend event log while folding in Claude's follow-ups for song/timing change records, taste action-dwell generator state, and derived listening/agitation/contagion/taste-display ephemeral guidance.
